question: Does adding only fight-scoped DRAW-event observations preserve the complete frozen clean current-main explicit-null path, RNG, policy and results across the full first-look cohort?

design.type: one-arm full-cohort observation identity preflight with a frozen common-random-number anchor; not a gameplay-factor experiment

matrix.source: same current-main plus one observation append

design.sharedAnchor: Both arms use the exact same 64 resolved Policy.sample_range identities, four simulation seed identities, current-main content, Duskblade Vow-5 baseline, explicit null, whole-run estimator and complete-cohort stopping rule.
design.mechanisticContrast: Remove only the new draws container from each observed row and require exact equality with its frozen anchor row. The remaining trajectory, result, RNG cursor and policy snapshot cannot differ.
design.aliasStructure: The anchor aliases draw telemetry with unavailable. No gameplay factor, candidate, payoff, acquisition priority, rarity or Ward setup level varies. There are no unmeasured joint cells to complete.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

acquisitionPriority.definition: Fixed exact sampled policy reward scoring.

drawTelemetry.definition: Observation-only append from the existing EventTypes.DRAW branch in BalanceSim._harvest_fight. The trace is never read by gameplay.

cohort.identity: The anchor slice is the frozen capture-on explicit-null arm. Every policy index and seed appears exactly once in the same order in the new arm; no identity can be selected, removed, replaced or added after execution.

traceDefinition.mediator: A concrete card instance was drawn during a known fight before any downstream play-selection claim.
traceDefinition.schema: Every captured row has a non-empty draws list; each entry has exactly four fields, non-negative fight, event and uid, and a non-empty card id.
traceDefinition.scope: Observation only. This preflight estimates identity, not draw co-availability, strategy activation, package, payoff, acquisition, balance or product acceptance.

estimands.pathIdentity: Exact canonical equality for all 256 paired rows after removing only draws from the new trajectory.
estimands.rngIdentity: Exact final RNG cursor equality for every pair.
estimands.policyIdentity: Exact resolved policy snapshot equality for every pair.
estimands.drawSchema: Zero schema or value faults across every observed draw event.
estimands.notEstimated: No gameplay endpoint, mediator activation rate, causal effect, complementarity, decision value, candidate feasibility, detector performance or optimisation benefit is estimated.

factorDisposition.candidate: None is constructed, simulated, frozen or promoted.
factorDisposition.payoffs: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate, fixed and absent.
factorDisposition.ponytailKnobs: No non-null research knob exists or is exercised.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser or fitted model is used or authorised.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python constructs the complete frozen row rectangle, executes it once, content-addresses the plan and output, performs exact paired comparisons and owns the stop/go decision.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: All 256 rows are the only look. No reserve, repair, rerun, row replacement or adaptive continuation exists.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This identity stage may authorise only a zero-row analysis of the resulting draw trace. It cannot support a causal or gameplay endpoint claim.

decisionRules.success: All 256 rows complete within 90 seconds; removing only draws yields exact anchor equality; RNG and policy identities have zero mismatches; the draw schema has zero faults; and the ledger remains exact.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze exactly the fight-scoped draw trace for one deterministic zero-row decomposition of draw co-availability versus downstream co-play. Do not add a candidate, payoff, gameplay hook, policy knob, causal row, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Any paired identity, RNG, policy, schema or ledger check fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close fight-scoped draw telemetry without repair or rerun. Continue inside issue #421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism; do not infer a policy bottleneck or add a method.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input is unavailable, the single process cannot produce the complete output, or the decision is unavailable at 90 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the preflight inconclusive at the cap. Add no row, repair, rerun, candidate, method or protected seed.
